task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Move BOX_TOP to TEMP_TABLE, then pick BOX_MIDDLE and place on INSPECTION_TABLE, then move BOX_TOP back to BOX_BOTTOM
assumptions: CAR robot starts at origin (0,0) with no held object
Only top of stack can be picked, so BOX_TOP must be moved first
TEMP_TABLE is available as temporary storage
BOX_MIDDLE is supported by BOX_BOTTOM and will be exposed after BOX_TOP removal
After placing BOX_MIDDLE on INSPECTION_TABLE, BOX_TOP needs to be returned to complete the 'removed middle box only' appearance
rtdl: def task RemoveMiddleBox(;){ state nav_success: bool; state nav_msg: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=-1.8,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP",location_name="TEMP_TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_MIDDLE";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=2.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_MIDDLE",location_name="INSPECTION_TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=-1.8,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP",location_name="BOX_BOTTOM";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
